name: Semple Sites Deploy
author: Trize Inc.

sections.description:
The Semple Sites Deploy plugin allows you to effortlessly convert your dynamic WordPress site into a highly optimized, blazing-fast static site. With a single click, it compiles all your published pages, posts, and assets into a lightweight Zip archive while obfuscating WordPress-specific paths to protect your site against platform-specific vulnerabilities. Connect it directly to your Semple API to deploy to the edge network instantly!

External services

This plugin connects to the Semple API (api.semple.io) to deploy your generated static site archive.
When a deployment is triggered by the user, the plugin securely transmits the generated ZIP file of your static site to the Semple API. This service is provided by Trize Inc.: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the semple-deploy folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Click on the “Semple Deployer” menu item in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. (Optional) Enter your Semple API Key and Site ID to enable 1-click deployments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect my live site?

No. It only creates a static copy of your site and packages it into a zip file. It does not alter your live database or themes.

Can I download the ZIP file manually?

Yes! Once compilation is complete, a “Download Archive” button will appear.
